docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,461.00 FILED BY HUET FABICE J AS TO DEFENDANT METRO PARK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-23-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 05
